title: When the Thorn Turns
author: Zephyrine Oyelaran
blurb: Coral Vane, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
